text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-eu-high-latency (sev: 2) — PD#PD12345 — Symptoms: p50/p95 latency spike, 5xx increase in eu-west-1. Auto-suppression: none. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

miguel (eng-oncall): acked in PD, joining bridge now — https://zoom.example/j/12345. grabbing logs + checking autoscaler.

sara (SRE): on standby if you need handoff. are we seeing queue growth or backend 5xx?

miguel (eng-oncall): initial quick grep shows kv-cache evictions + a burst of long seq requests. small spike in qdepth on embed-queue. tail of runtime logs: `2026-03-17T12:34:01Z inference: request_id=abc123 latency=3200ms status=200` and `2026-03-17T12:34:05Z inference: request_id=def456 latency=50ms status=502`.

jay (support): customers reporting timeouts in EU dashboard. any list of affected customers? need to notify CS for impacted accounts.

miguel (eng-oncall): grabbing customer-impact from traces now — preliminary: ~12 tenants, mostly small bursty apps. pushing a short note to #customers immediately.

zoe (infra): looking at dedicated pools — autoscaler shows a transient failure to scale GPU pool: kube HPA threw `failed to get metrics` at 12:33:57. I'm manually triggering a scale to +2 nodes: `kubectl apply -f scale-temporary.yaml` (doing now).

miguel (eng-oncall): running quick mitigation: bumped pool, flushed prefix cache on hot shards, toggled fallback routing to lower-capacity model for low-priority routes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: miguel (eng-oncall) acknowledged at 2026-03-17T12:35:10Z.

miguel (eng-oncall): scale completed ~30s ago. errors dropping: 5xx rate from 3.1% -> 0.9%. p95 latency down from 4.2s -> 1.1s and trending. still monitoring for KV eviction recurrence.

sara (SRE): thanks — can you paste the exact commands you ran for the cache flush and the fallback? need it in the ticket for the runbook.

miguel (eng-oncall): flush command: ```bash
# flush hot prefixes on shard-7
redis-cli -h redis-7.example EVAL "return redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])" 1 hotprefix:shard:7
```
Fallback toggle: `redwood route update --route embed-priority --fallback-model small-embed-v2 --until 2026-03-17T13:00:00Z`

zoe (infra): FYI autoscaler logs show intermittent metrics API 503s between 12:32-12:34. I'm opening infra-ops ticket to audit metrics exporter and HPA auth.

jay (support): flagged affected tenants in CS tracker and sent templated email w/ status. pinged top 3 customers by usage.

miguel (eng-oncall): monitoring 10m window. If metrics look stable I'll hand off ownership to sara for post-incident follow-up and RCA.

sara (SRE): please add a short timeline + links to logs to the incident ticket and assign to me for RCA. I'll also confirm customer follow-up actions.

miguel (eng-oncall): added timeline + logs to incident ticket PD12345 and assigned to sara. Handoff: miguel -> sara at 2026-03-17T12:45:30Z.

sara (SRE): taking ownership. will run heap/profile checks and coordinate with zoe on autoscaler fix. thanks for fast mitigation :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging — state: monitoring. PD#PD12345 updated: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring).
